units.source_text: “不知怎的，我只顾看镜子里映现的天空——

en.t: Somehow, I kept looking only at the sky reflected in the mirror—

units.source_text: 镜子把天空映照得那么美，

en.t: the mirror reflected the sky so beautifully,

units.source_text: 大概也会把我的脸蛋照得比实际更标致吧，

en.t: so it would probably make my face look prettier than it really was, too,

units.source_text: 这是一面照什么都显得漂亮的镜子。”

en.t: a mirror that makes anything it reflects look beautiful.”
